# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

DataLens is currently under active development. Security fixes will be applied to the latest version of the project.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in DataLens, please report it privately to the repository owner through GitHub rather than creating a public issue.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- The potential impact.
- Any suggested mitigation, if available.

Please do not publicly disclose the vulnerability until it has been reviewed and addressed.

## Data Privacy

DataLens uses synthetic student data for demonstration and development purposes.

The project should not be used with real personally identifiable student information without appropriate security, privacy, and authorization measures.
